subject: SolacePay: Priority account readout + ownership timetable
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@solacepay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@solacepay.com; Anita Singh <anita.singh@solacepay.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SolacePay - Major latency & error spike impacting checkout

Hi Ava,

We had a major incident this morning between 02:00-04:30 UTC where our checkout calls to Redwood’s hosted inference API experienced 5-8s tail latency and a sustained 15% 5xx error rate. Throughput dropped ~40% as retries piled up; several customers reported failed payments. This is high-severity for our business — we lost transactions.

We need an immediate readout: what caused it, whether it’s fully mitigated, and what the plan is to prevent recurrence. Procurement copied here as they will need details for any SLA credits. Anita (CISO) requested evidence that no sensitive data was exposed.

Can you confirm receipt and give an ETA for a preliminary RCA?

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Engineering, SolacePay
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@solacepay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolacePay - Major latency & error spike impacting checkout

Tom — received, and we’re treating this as priority. Immediate notes:
- I’ve paged on-call and SRE, and Grace is aware at the exec level.
- We are collecting traces, span samples, and token-level latency histograms for the 02:00–04:30 UTC window.
- Preliminary mitigation (already applied): route new checkout requests to a pinned model replica in a different region and enable prefix KV cache for SolacePay routes. That reduced errors for a subset of traffic within 20 minutes.

ETA for preliminary RCA: 48 hours (we’ll share incident_summary + timeline). Full RCA with corrective actions and ownership: 5 business days.

I’ll share a readout doc shortly and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through findings.

—Ava
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@solacepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SolacePay - Major latency & error spike impacting checkout

Tom / Ava — quick operational update before the readout:
- Root cause (prelim): a regression in request batching logic triggered by a rare sequence-length distribution in SolacePay production traffic. That caused inefficient kernel selection on the GPU pool serving your customer shard, producing queueing and 5xx backpressure.
- Mitigations performed: forced short-window continuous batching disabled for your shard, routed traffic to a larger instance pool, and applied additional hotfix to kernel selection heuristics.
- Current state: error rate down to ~0.5% across the last 3 hours; tail latency returned to expected 120–200ms P95 for checkout flows.

Next steps we will document in the RCA: long-term change to kernel selection heuristics, traffic-profile gating to prevent pathological batch decisions, and a policy to pre-warm capacity for rapid catch-up.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: permanent kernel selector patch (ETA 7 business days)
- Ben: capacity policy + autoscale threshold change (ETA 3 business days)
- Ava: customer-facing RCA and credits proposal (ETA 48 hours)

Neha
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@solacepay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@solacepay.com; Anita Singh <anita.singh@solacepay.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 13:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolacePay - Major latency & error spike impacting checkout

Thanks for the quick mitigation. A few asks from SolacePay:
1) We need a signed SLA credit agreement and a proposal for monetary credits for the outage window. Procurement expects a draft tomorrow.
2) Anita needs the audit of what internal services accessed SolacePay payloads during the incident (request logs, access logs). Please include log retention windows.
3) We want a low-touch way to opt into the pre-warm policy during Q4 peaks — what does that cost and how to enable it?

Can you confirm those will be in the final RCA?

- Tom
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@solacepay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: SolacePay - Incident readout, RCA, and ownership timetable (attached)

Tom / Anita / procurement team — attached is the incident readout (solacepay_incident_summary_20270330.pdf) and the proposed credits agreement (proposed_credits_agreement.docx). Highlights:
- Timeline and cause: regression in batching kernel selection (detailed timeline pages 2–4).
- Impact: 02:00–04:30 UTC, estimated failed transactions: ~1,280; revenue impact estimate included.
- Remediation completed: hotfix to kernel selector + temporary routing to pre-warmed pool (see mitigation_runbook.md).
- Evidence for audit: request and access logs for the incident window are available via the secure bucket (link in Doc). No internal service stored full user payment data beyond ephemeral traces; payment payloads are never persisted by Redwood per our data-handling policy.

Ownership & commitments (short summary):
- Karthik Iyer — permanent kernel selector patch; PR in review; expected deploy 2027-04-07 (owner: k_i@redwood).
- Ben Carter — autoscale tuning & pre-warm offering spec; customer opt-in pricing and enablement by 2027-04-04.
- Neha Kapoor — verify canary + e2e traces after patch; validate in staging by 2027-04-05.
- Ava Chen — finalize credits agreement and sign-off; provide execution copy to procurement by 2027-04-01.

Proposed next steps: 30-minute readout with execs + SolacePay tomorrow (2027-03-31 14:00 UTC). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the mitigation runbook and the Jira ticket OPS-8819 for tracking.

Attachments referenced: solacepay_incident_summary_20270330.pdf, mitigation_runbook.md, proposed_credits_agreement.docx

Thanks — we own this and will follow through on the commitments above.

—Ava
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: SolacePay escalation - exec readout and next steps

Team — thanks for rapid response and clear ownership. A few executive notes for the internal readout:
- Confirmed customer impact and current remediation status (Neha summary is accurate).
- Priority: deliver the permanent kernel selector fix and the pre-warm opt-in by the dates Ava summarized. These are the two items SolacePay flagged as blockers to renew discussions.
- Credits: approve up to 3 days' worth of service credits (finance to finalize amount). Ava, please finalize the agreement and get procurement signature by Friday.
- Customer ops: schedule a post-deploy validation with SolacePay (Neha + Ben to lead).

I’m briefing leadership in tomorrow’s 10:00 AM slot; please send any slides or 1-pagers to me by 08:00 AM. We’ll track in OPS-8819 and report closure in the weekly exec ops digest.

Grace
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
